hints.title: Bitwise Aggregation
hints.text: Aggregate bitwise operations collapse multiple permission masks into single summary masks.

hints.title: Intersection and Union
hints.text: Common permissions across all users require bitwise and, while any permission across at least one user requires bitwise OR.

hints.title: Aggregate Functions
hints.text: Use BIT_AND(permissions) for common_perms and BIT_OR(permissions) for any_perms.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT 
    BIT_AND(permissions) AS common_perms,
    BIT_OR(permissions) AS any_perms
FROM user_permissions;
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single aggregation pass is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage SQL standard bitwise aggregation functions BIT_AND and BIT_OR.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    BIT_AND(permissions) AS common_perms,
    BIT_OR(permissions) AS any_perms
FROM user_permissions;

SELECT 
    bit_and(permissions) AS common_perms,
    bit_or(permissions) AS any_perms
FROM user_permissions;
